title: Oracle CDC Operations Center
description: End-to-End Monitoring for the Oracle Debezium CDC Pipeline

panels.description: Healthy only when Oracle is open, LogMiner connected, the task running, Kafka up, the archive destination valid and the recovery area under 90%

targets.expr: (max(oracledb_db_open_rw) * max(debezium_metrics_connected{context="streaming"}) * clamp_max(min(kafka_connect_worker_connector_running_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}), 1) * (max(kafka_connect_worker_connector_failed_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) == bool 0) * clamp_max(max(kafka_brokers), 1) * min(oracledb_archive_dest_valid) * (max(oracledb_fra_used_bytes / oracledb_fra_limit_bytes) < bool 0.9)) or vector(0)

0.text: ✖  Attention Needed   |   a component is down, missing or over a limit

1.text: ✔  All Systems Healthy   |   Oracle CDC pipeline is running normally

targets.expr: (clamp_max(max(kafka_brokers), 1) * ((sum(kafka_topic_partition_under_replicated_partition) or vector(0)) == bool 0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.description: Seconds Debezium is behind Oracle. IDLE: no change captured since the connector started.
SAFE: archive destination VALID and recovery area under 80%. Subtitle: age of the oldest archive log on disk.

targets.expr: ((((100 * oracledb_fra_used_bytes / oracledb_fra_limit_bytes) < bool 80) + ((100 * oracledb_fra_used_bytes / oracledb_fra_limit_bytes) < bool 90)) * on() min(oracledb_archive_dest_valid)) or on() vector(-1)

100 * (clamp_max(max(kafka_brokers), 1) + ((sum(kafka_topic_partition_under_replicated_partition) or vector(0)) == bool 0) + ((sum(kafka_consumergroup_lag) or vector(0)) < bool 1000) + max(up{job="kafka"})) / 4

panels.title: 4. Retention & CDC Lag
panels.description: Required SCN is where the connector resumes from; it must stay at or above the oldest archive SCN.

targets.expr: ((max(debezium_metrics_offsetscn{context="streaming"}) >= bool scalar(oracledb_archive_log_oldest_scn)) and on() (oracledb_archive_log_oldest_scn > 0)) or on() vector(-1)
(max(up{job="cdc-es-sync"}) * ((sum(increase(cdc_errors_total[10m])) or vector(0)) == bool 0)) or on() vector(-1)

defaults.noValue: No alerts in the last 24 hours

ConnectorBehindOldestArchiveLog.text: Connector position no longer on disk
